ideas.text: An AI that detects reply-all chains with 40+ recipients and seals the thread in a vault.
A bot that unsubscribes from every newsletter you haven't opened in 60 days while you sleep.
An app that detects 'per my last email' and automatically attaches the last email.
A tool that converts a 12-paragraph email into the 2-sentence ask that was buried in paragraph 9.
An AI that detects when you wrote 'please see attached' and forgot to attach anything.
A bot that stops you from sending an email at 11pm and schedules it for 9am with 'I had a thought—' removed.
An app that detects when you've been cc'd on something that has nothing to do with you and quietly removes you.
A tool that converts your angry draft email into a professional one and asks if you're sure before sending.
An AI that detects when someone replied all to 400 people to say 'thanks!' and retroactively removes them from all future lists.
A bot that detects 'as discussed' in an email and attaches the discussion that was allegedly had.
An app that blocks emails from being sent to more than 5 people unless the sender can justify each recipient.
A tool that identifies which emails have been sitting in your 'action needed' folder since 2022.
An AI that scores your email subject lines on a scale of 'legible' to 'fwd: fwd: re: re: quick q.'
A bot that detects when a thread has 47 replies and extracts just the last decision, if there was one.
An app that flags when your email is passive-aggressive and shows you what it sounds like to the recipient.
A tool that intercepts 'just following up' emails and asks you to try again with what you actually need.
An AI that blocks sending to 'undisclosed recipients' from corporate accounts and generates a legal concern.
A bot that detects when someone sent you a calendar invite with no description and emails them to ask what it's for.
An app that auto-generates an out-of-office reply that accurately captures how checked out you actually are.
A tool that detects when your inbox has become a to-do list and archives everything older than 30 days.
An AI that converts 'hope this finds you well' into the content of the email and deletes the pleasantry.
A bot that detects when you've opened the same email 6 times without responding and asks what's going on.
An app that identifies which emails require a 3-word response and stops you from writing 3 paragraphs.
A tool that detects when you've been cc'd as a political move and explains the politics in a side note.
An AI that detects when a reply-all was an accident and intercepts the follow-up 'sorry, ignore me' email.
A bot that sends the email you've been sitting on for 5 days with one tap, before you edit it for the 11th time.
An app that detects when your email signature is longer than your email and trims it to one line.
A tool that converts every 'we should connect sometime' into either a meeting invite or a polite archive.
An AI that detects when an email chain should have been a 5-minute call and schedules one.
A bot that reads emails marked 'high priority' by the sender and estimates the actual urgency independently.
An app that detects when an email was clearly written while driving and adds a wellness check to the response.
A tool that identifies the person on your team who generates 40% of internal email volume and sends them a Slack.
An AI that automatically declines meeting requests sent via email that don't have a clear purpose in the subject line.
A bot that detects when you've used 'ASAP' and replaces it with an actual date and time.
An app that generates your weekly email stats and compares them to your actual output that week.
A tool that detects when you're ccing your manager to make a point and tells you to make the point directly instead.
An AI that converts a vague 'can you take a look at this?' email into a specific request with context attached.
A bot that detects when the same question was emailed to 6 different people and merges all the responses.
An app that auto-replies to cold sales emails with a polished 'no thank you' that's kinder than your usual ignore.
A tool that detects when you've been looped in via bcc and logs the political implications for your records.
An AI that detects when a company announcement email was written by committee and softens exactly 30% of the adjectives.
A bot that detects when a legal disclaimer in an email footer is longer than the email itself.
An app that intercepts emails written in all caps and converts them to a normal register before sending.
A tool that detects when someone has been waiting 10 business days for a reply and drafts a follow-up for you.
An AI that reads all the emails in your 'someday' folder and tells you which ones no longer apply.
A bot that identifies which newsletters you subscribed to after a conference in 2018 and still receive.
An app that detects when an email is a veiled complaint and offers a rewrite or a meeting to sort it out.
A tool that converts every 'friendly reminder' into an accurate assessment of how friendly it actually is.
An AI that detects when you've replied to an email thread started in 2020 and warns everyone before you do.
A bot that detects when your OOO message promises to 'get back to you as soon as possible' and sets a specific date instead.
An app that shows you your actual inbox zero success rate per year as a percentage, formatted as a grade.
A tool that detects when you've been added to a mailing list and traces which form you accidentally checked.
An AI that identifies the 5 people whose emails always require a meeting to resolve and asks if Slack would be faster.
A bot that detects when you've sent an email to the wrong person and checks in on you 30 seconds later.
